Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 11943 (Part 10) -1987 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR HARD METAL BURRS 

Part 10 CONICAL ROUND - (BALL-) NOSE BURRS ( TYPE L ) 



1 . Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements of hard metal burrs of conical shape with 
a round - ( ball - ) nose. Type L. 



2. Dimensions

All dimensions in millimetres.

3. General Requirements— For requirements not covered in this standard it shall conform to 
IS : 11943 ( Part 1 ) - 1987 'Specification for hard metal burrs: Part 1 Technical supply conditions'. 

4. Marking— Shall be marked with designation code and the manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 
4.1 Certification Marking— Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXP LA N ATO RY NOTE 

This Part 10 of the standard covers the hard metal burrs of Type L. The different types of hard 
metal burrs are covered in Parts 2 to 12 and the technical supply conditions are covered in Part 1 of 
this standard- 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from ISO 7755/10- 
1984 'Hard metal burrs— Part 10 Conical round (bail) nose burrs (style L)', issued by the Inter- 
national Organization for Standardization ( ISO ).
